Cast: Kazuya Kamenashi, Takuya Satou, Maaya Uchida.
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- returns this month with Season 4 Part 2.
After the intense battle for Priestella, Subaru and his allies may have secured a hard-fought victory, but the cost was far greater than they could have imagined.
With Rem, Crusch, and Julius left facing uncertain fates, Subaru sets out on another journey in search of a way to save them.
His only hope lies with Shaula, the legendary "Wise Woman" who lives in the mysterious Pleiades Watchtower and is said to possess limitless knowledge.
To reach the Pleiades Watchtower, Subaru and his friends must cross the deadly Auguria Dunes, an unforgiving desert filled with monstrous creatures and other dangers that hide in every corner.
With higher stakes than ever and another mystery waiting to be unraveled, Season 4 Part 2 looks set to deliver the suspense, heartbreak, and unforgettable twists that have made the series a fan favorite for nearly a decade.
